name: Zenith
design_intent:
ZENITH — THE HIGH WIRE #10 (tier 2, radial spike of verticality). A rim of four low perches surrounds a single VERY HIGH central spring throne (+560 over the top perches), over a deep dusk void — spikey radial verticality where the whole fight orbits one contested apex. Two upper perches and two lower perches sit at the rim; the throne floats dead-centre far above them. Kill identity = knock rivals off the rim into the void, or off the throne straight down the central column. kill_shape = void_is_floor. Signature: radial like atoll, but built AROUND a towering central prize rather than a well (atoll = knock INTO the middle; Zenith = the middle is the throne everyone climbs for). Feel = 'claw up to the summit throne while everyone tries to knock you off it.'

GEOMETRY (centred x=0): top-left/top-right perches (trampoline, top y600) up at the rim; bottom-left/bottom-right perches (trampoline, top y1120) lower and inboard; central THRONE (spring, top y40) hovering 560px above the top perches over the central void.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270 / spring 480; drift ~395 trampoline / ~527 spring MAX; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 600px in ~0.9s; super 2800 clears all, rises ~2450). Perches TL(-1600..-1000 top600) TR(1000..1600 top600) BL(-1400..-800 top1120) BR(800..1400 top1120); throne x-200..200 top40:
- CLIMB BL->TL (and BR->TR): the lower perch to the upper perch is a 520px vertical climb (x-overlapping). Trampoline apex 270 reaches only 250px short. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY. (Rule B, >= 520.)
- CROSS BL<->BR over the centre: bottom perches' inner edges x-800..x800 = 1600px over the deep central void. Far > 527. NORMAL BOOST (or super) REQUIRED; miss = fall down the middle. Verb: FLY. (Rule A.)
- CROSS TL<->TR over the centre: inner edges x-1000..x1000 = 2000px over the void. NORMAL BOOST / SUPER REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB to the THRONE (top y40): 560px above the top perches (600), 1080px above the bottom perches, over the open central column. Spring apex 480 from a top perch falls 80px short; an under-shot drops straight down. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY (+ SUPER earns the summit). (Rule B.)
- RECOVER: bottom perch bottom 1248 -> bottom blast line 2160 = 912px of recovery sky (2120px under the throne) -> a fuelled knock boosts back to a rim perch; a throne knock spikes down the central column. Verb: FLY.
- No bounce route crosses the rim or climbs the throne, so the jetpack is required to move at all. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing, not scenery.
